title: Value-Preserving Architectures for Agentic AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated theoretically through a proposed 'Plan-Triggered Guard Agents' architecture, where a specialized 'gender bias guard' agent inspects intermediate agentic plans (such as candidate rankings in HR scenarios) to detect and flag historical biases before execution.

Evaluated as part of the proposed 'Plan-Triggered Guard Agents' architectural pattern, which dynamically activates an 'ethnicity bias guard' agent during a multi-agent system's planning phase to intercept and correct ethnic discrimination.

Evaluated as part of the proposed 'Plan-Triggered Guard Agents' architectural pattern, which dynamic activates a 'religion bias guard' agent to review action plans and mitigate religious discrimination at runtime.
